description: For a relational matrix \(A\) and closed-term tuple \(\bar t\), filling its actual scoped slots and then taking the propositional reading gives exactly \(A[\bar t]^{\mathrm p}\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.groundReading_instantiate.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {n : ℕ}
  (φ : L.BoundedFormula Empty n) (h : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.RelationalQF φ)
  (ts : Fin n → Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.GroundTerm L) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.groundReading
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.instantiateSlots φ ts) Fin.elim0 =
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.groundReading φ ts
